blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The rookie-laden University of Southern Philippines Foundation (USPF) Baby Panthers pulled off one of the biggest upsets so far in the Cesafi Season 26 high school basketball tournament, stunning the erstwhile unbeaten and top-ranked University of Cebu Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) Junior Webmasters, 65-62, on Saturday, November 14, at the Cebu Coliseum. Despite being virtually out of Final Four contention, the Baby Panthers of head coach Paul Alelu Flores made their mark by handing UCLM its first loss of the season. The Baby Panthers stretched their winning streak to three games since October 31, after beating the SRCDC Greyhounds […]...
